Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PRODUCTION transparent PNG icon atlas for an installable desktop icon theme called Calibra Stickers. Create a gorgeous cohesive pack of colorful DIE-CUT VINYL STICKERS: flat illustrated objects with gently rounded shapes, bold dark-indigo interior outlines, warm bright coral, butter yellow, jade, teal, lavender and pink fills, tiny highlight details, a thick clean WHITE die-cut border following each object's full silhouette and a very subtle lower-right drop shadow. Friendly polished stationery sticker style, simple readable app-ready silhouettes. NOT clay, NOT glossy 3D, NOT pencil drawing. No faces or random decoration. Square atlas, EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS by SIX ROWS, 36 equally sized cells. One standalone complete sticker centered in each cell, the entire white edge and shadow fit inside the central 72% of the cell. Generous equal TRANSPARENT gutters. Background genuinely transparent: do not add sheets, paper squares, colored tiles, visible grid lines, captions, numbers, watermarks or extra stickers. No printed text except explicitly requested icon glyphs. Stickers have consistent scale, outline weight, white edge thickness, palette and shadow direction. Strict row-major subjects:
Row 1: jade closed book with coral plus badge (add books); lavender document with yellow pencil (metadata); two coral and teal curved arrows forming a circle (convert); open cream book with coral cover (read); teal paper airplane (send); lavender floppy disk with coral details (save).
Row 2: butter yellow folded newspaper (news); three connected teal nodes (share); coral waste bin (remove); lavender adjustment sliders with yellow knobs (preferences); open jade book with yellow pencil (edit book); three golden sparkles (polish).
Row 3: three upright colorful books (library); coral magnifying glass with pale teal lens (search); jade hang tag (tags); three stacked pastel layers (series); lavender spiral notebook with yellow tabs (catalog); coral shopping bag (store).
Row 4: simple teal human bust silhouette (author); lavender jigsaw piece (plugins); cream blank document with folded corner (file); yellow folder; lavender e-reader tablet; teal desktop monitor with pink screen.
Row 5: pink heart; golden five-point star; coral calendar; jade envelope; teal globe; lavender printer.
Row 6: teal down arrow into yellow tray (download); coral up arrow from yellow tray (upload); yellow open cardboard box (unpack); lavender interlocking chain links; pink sticky note; teal cloud with yellow down arrow (metadata download).
No explanatory labels. Every icon has its own complete, thick white sticker border and gentle shadow.
